# Las Vegas Leak Detection Services — Las Vegas, Nevada

> 24/7 Non-invasive water, slab, swimming pool, and gas leak detection in Las Vegas, Nevada — serving Northwest Las Vegas & Lone Mountain (89129), Centennial Hills (89131 / 89149), Summerlin (89135 / 89144), The Lakes & Peccole Ranch (89117), Spring Valley & Spanish Trail (89103 / 89113), Rhodes Ranch (89148), Paradise, and Downtown Las Vegas (89101).

Las Vegas Leak Detection Services coordinates 24/7 non-destructive leak diagnostics and precision repair in Las Vegas, NV through independent Nevada State Contractors Board (NSCB) licensed specialists. Dispatched technicians deploy ultrasonic acoustic listening systems, FLIR infrared thermal imaging, helium/hydrogen tracer gas sniffing, and submersible pool hydrophones to pinpoint hidden leaks without exploratory demolition.

## Core Non-Invasive Services in Las Vegas, NV
- [Water Leak Detection](https://www.leakdetectionnv.com/water-leak-detection/): High-sensitivity acoustic correlators and FLIR thermal cameras to trace concealed supply pipe failures, slab pinhole splits, and yard mains without exploratory drywall cuts.
- [Slab Leak Detection](https://www.leakdetectionnv.com/slab-leak-detection/): Pinpointing pressurized copper and PEX hot/cold lines ruptured under post-tension concrete slab foundations across Las Vegas, enabling spot repairs or overhead PEX repiping.
- [Pool & Spa Leak Detection](https://www.leakdetectionnv.com/pool-leak-detection/): Electronic listening hydrophones, structural dye tests, skimmer throat inspections, and line pressure testing without draining pools.
- [Gas Leak Detection](https://www.leakdetectionnv.com/gas-leak-detection/): Digital PPM sniffer devices, ultrasonic detectors, and calibrated manometer drop tests for Southwest Gas natural gas lines, outdoor kitchens, and pool heaters.
- [Underground Leak Detection](https://www.leakdetectionnv.com/underground-leak-detection/): Ground-penetrating acoustic sensors and safe tracer gas for fractured irrigation lines and LVVWD street-to-home water mains buried in desert caliche soil.
- [Emergency Leak Repair](https://www.leakdetectionnv.com/emergency-leak-repair/): 24/7 rapid dispatch across Las Vegas for active water floods, burst mains, and gas shutoffs.

## Diagnostic Equipment & Methodology
1. **Acoustic Frequency Filtration**: Amplifies the precise sonic signature of pressurized water escaping tiny fissures beneath concrete slabs, tile, and pavers.
2. **Infrared Thermal Thermography**: Maps surface temperature gradients to reveal hot-water slab lines, wall leaks, and hidden moisture saturation.
3. **Helium / Hydrogen Tracer Gas**: Non-toxic, inert gas pressurization detected at parts-per-million levels through compacted desert caliche soil and concrete patios.
4. **Endoscopic Video Inspection**: High-definition fiber-optic cameras inserted into sewer, drain, and ventilation conduits.
